<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Doctor integration, the LIVE install on this machine, and the artifact Jordan actually runs. THIS PHASE TOUCHES THE REAL HOME DIRECTORY — every earlier phase was fenced away from it on purpose, and that fence comes down here, deliberately and once. Two measured facts govern the order of work. (1) backupAgentConfigs IS WRITE-ONLY: it flattens each path into one directory with a __ substitution and NOTHING reverses the mapping, so 'we take a backup first' is reassurance that does no work — a restore point must be proven to restore BEFORE anything writes. (2) THIS MACHINE HAS NO PRISTINE BASELINE: ~/.cursor/hooks.json holds no standalone git-ai entry, because git-ai's checkpoint invocation is a pipeline stage inside a chained command the attribution POC wrote, and that chain is the evidence base for phase 1's only end-to-end measurement. Comparisons are against RECORDED PRE-INSTALL BYTES, never an idealised config. A pre-install byte snapshot of five agent configs already exists outside the repo with digests recorded; it is insurance, not the deliverable.
